scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d sonar_db sonarqube openclaw-gateway
scripts.prod:up: docker compose --env-file deploy/.env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile sonar --profile openclaw up -d --build
scripts.prod:down: docker compose --env-file deploy/.env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile sonar --profile openclaw down
scripts.prod:ps: docker compose --env-file deploy/.env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile sonar --profile openclaw ps
scripts.prod:config: docker compose --env-file deploy/.env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile sonar --profile openclaw config
scripts.prod:openclaw:cli: docker compose --env-file deploy/.env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm openclaw-cli
